name: Childrens Ministry
overview: Scripture reveals the vital importance of children's ministry by emphasizing the responsibility to diligently teach and train children in God's ways, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:7 and Proverbs 22:6. Children are portrayed as a precious heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3) whose purity and conduct reflect their upbringing (Proverbs 20:11). Jesus Himself warns against despising children, highlighting their special place before God and the protection of their angels (Matthew 18:10). Moreover, even the youngest are instruments of God's strength against His enemies (Psalms 8:2), underscoring the spiritual significance of nurturing faith in children.
